The '''MV-2 messenger unit''' was a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was used during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] sent an MV-2 messenger unit to meet a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and send the Padawan to speak with Yoda in the temple's [[Jedi Council Chamber/Legends|High Council Chamber]]. The droid escorted the Padawan to the chamber and once Yoda had finished briefing the individual, beckoned to the Padawan to follow it. The droid then told the Jedi to leave from [[spaceport H1]] immediately, and that a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was waiting there for the Padawan.
